description: This source file defines the TypeCodec class responsible for serializing and deserializing type information, including reading and writing type identifiers with support for versioning, caching, and conversions. It manages internal caches for type keys and supports length-prefixed and encoded type reading/writing.

classes.name: TypeCodec
classes.description: Provides functionality for serializing and deserializing type information, including writing length-prefixed and encoded types, reading types for both serialization and diagnostics, and managing internal caches for type keys.

classes.name: TypeCodec.TypeKey
classes.description: Represents a unique identifier for a type, including a hash code and the type name as a byte array, with equality and string representation implementations.

methods.name: WriteLengthPrefixed
methods.description: Serializes a type with a length prefix, writing the length of the type name followed by the name bytes.

methods.name: WriteEncodedType
methods.description: Serializes a type with versioning, hash code, and type name, suitable for decoding with version support.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read a type from binary data, matching against cached entries, and parsing via the type converter if necessary.

methods.name: ReadLengthPrefixed
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed type, extracting the type name and converting it to a Type object.

methods.name: TryReadForAnalysis
methods.description: Reads a type for diagnostic purposes, providing type object and name string, without caching effects.
